policy: Fixed per compatible build; add owners/fields explicitly on arrival, change rules identity and affected versions; refuse incompatible development saves. Never infer registry at runtime.

wire.note: Framing is 4 (store_count) + 33 (owner wrapper: 4 key length + 9 'residents' + 4 owner_schema_version + 8 primary_count + 8 payload_byte_length) = 37. The retained inner row_count is validated against primary_count, and payload_byte_length against length - 37 from the descriptor. Neither framing count nor the wrapper becomes an extra canonical record. Decision 0112.

nonrecord_sections.2: exact canonical catalog artifact is covered by catalog identity; mutable movement profile revision remains a separate record
nonrecord_sections.15: canonical_state_hash;32 raw SHA256 bytes; not its own input

release_blockers: Reconcile every changed or added module in the executing integration branch, including concurrent injury, economy and event work; do not use snapshot record_count blindly.
Validate every owner value adapter, unused-slot normalization, reference namespace and dynamic count against owning contracts; prose null rules are not executable validation.
Implement all required save section bodies and restore orchestration; this is a logical record registry, not a claim those bodies exist.
Register progression, community, economy/hazard and other future authoritative state at implementation arrival; reserved undeclared state must not be fabricated as zeros.
Produce complete rules and lookup manifests and prove section15 plus cross-process continuation parity; no subset digest qualifies release.
